text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket got a failing grade recently, so I'm keeping her company as she studies for her makeup exam.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hrmmmm… I don't get this at all…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Substitute the numbers? What does that mean? Find the… "sum"? Of the "variables"? What the heck?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: No, this is no good! If I give up here, I won't be able to train and enter races!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I've just gotta go all-out and get this done!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoa… Huh? Whoaaa, my head hurts…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On top of having to struggle with studying, trying too hard gives Winning Ticket a headache…
